title: Proof of Payment Flow
seoDescription: A returning-user payment verification flow balancing security, speed, and a frictionless mobile experience.
deck: A returning-user payment verification flow balancing security, speed, and a frictionless mobile experience.

blocks.heading: Making verification feel fast without weakening trust.
blocks.left: Returning customers needed a clear way to confirm payment while keeping sensitive financial information protected.
blocks.right: The flow reduced unnecessary repetition, clarified system feedback, and preserved the controls required by compliance.

blocks.quote: The complete process, screens, and outcomes will be added through the CMS.
